title: Luxuriantly Garlicky Algerian Pork Knuckle Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic one-pot dish featuring pork knuckle, score-fat, and a blend of Algerian spices, carefully prepared to be Buddhist-temple-friendly by using no animal by-products and ensuring a respectful cooking process.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the pork knuckle and brown it on all sides.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the meat is easily shredded with a fork.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
